answer_1.quote: We fine-tune ELMER on three popular text generation tasks... (XSUM, SQuAD v1.1, PersonaChat).
answer_1.outputs: Generated summaries, questions, and dialogue responses

answer_2.quote: We adopt four evaluation metrics: ROUGE-n, BLEU-n, METEOR, and Distinct-n.

answer_4.quote: Three workers were asked to score texts from four aspects, i.e., fluency, informativeness, accuracy, and relevance. These four scores are rated from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated text on fluency, informativeness, accuracy, and relevance using a 1–5 Likert scale.
